mergedParams.userDescription: Organic, handwritten script appearing slowly, like ink spreading on paper. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Handwritten Script with Ink Spread Animation

prompts.prompt: Create a typography preset that simulates organic ink spreading on paper using a reveal mask technique. Think of this like layering video tracks in a timeline where the text is always present but revealed through an animated mask that mimics liquid ink flow. The animation should start from the text's baseline and spread outward irregularly, like watching time-lapse footage of ink absorption. Use multiple TextAtom components with staggered timing - each word should have its own ink spread effect that begins slightly after the previous word (100-200ms delay). Apply a subtle texture overlay using CSS filters to simulate paper grain. The ink should appear to have varying opacity as it spreads, darker at the origin point and lighter at the edges, creating depth like a real ink bleed effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full' containing individual TextAtom components for each word. Each TextAtom wrapped in a BaseLayout with 'relative inline-block overflow-hidden' and a custom clip-path animation. Use generic keyframe effects with clip-path property animating from 'polygon(50% 100%, 50% 100%, 50% 100%)' to 'polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%)' with custom bezier easing (0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1). Add a secondary opacity effect from 0.3 to 1 over the same duration. Apply CSS filter 'contrast(1.2) brightness(0.95)' for ink texture. Duration: 400-600ms per word with 150ms stagger. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' on parent container. Consider using internal effect preset for reusable ink-spread effect.

prompts.prompt: Design a handwritten script animation that uses stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset SVG techniques, similar to the write-on effect in After Effects. Each letter should be drawn as if by an invisible hand, with natural speed variations - faster on straight strokes, slower on curves. Think of this as rotoscoping actual handwriting footage. The text should use a script font rendered as SVG paths within a ShapeAtom component. Add a subtle hand shake effect using small translateX/Y movements (1-2px amplitude) synchronized with the drawing speed to simulate human imperfection. Include a faint 'ghost writer' effect where a barely visible preview of the complete text appears first (5% opacity), then gets traced over by the main animation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full' containing ShapeAtom components for SVG text paths. Convert text to SVG paths server-side using fetcher. Apply stroke-dasharray equal to path length and animate stroke-dashoffset from path length to 0. Use generic keyframe effects with easing 'cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)' for natural hand movement. Add secondary transform effect with small random translateX (-2 to 2px) and translateY (-1 to 1px) values at 60ms intervals. Ghost text: duplicate ShapeAtom at z-index -1 with opacity 0.05 and blur(0.5px). Total duration: 2-3 seconds for average title length. Use presetExecution to calculate path lengths and generate timing arrays.

prompts.prompt: Implement a wet ink bleed effect where text appears to be written with too much ink that spreads and settles. Picture dropping ink onto wet paper in slow motion - initial impact, rapid spread, then gradual settling. Start with text at 150% scale with heavy blur (8-10px), then animate to 100% scale with blur reducing to 0. Add a color shift effect where the ink starts darker (multiply blend mode) and gradually lightens to normal. Include random 'splatter' particles around each letter using small circular divs that appear and fade during the initial impact phase. The animation should feel organic and liquid, like watching high-speed camera footage of ink dynamics.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative' containing TextAtom with initial className 'scale-150 blur-lg mix-blend-multiply'. Use generic keyframe effects: scale from 1.5 to 1 (600ms, ease-out), blur from 10 to 0 (800ms, ease-in-out), opacity from 0.6 to 1 (400ms). Splatter particles: repeatChildrenProps with 5-8 BaseLayout divs per letter, className 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-current', random positioning using style prop. Particle effects: scale from 0 to 1 to 0, opacity from 1 to 0, duration 300-500ms with random delays. Use internal effect preset 'ink-bleed' for main animation, 'ink-splatter' for particles. Consider caption data for word-level timing if using with captions.

prompts.prompt: Create a calligraphy brush stroke animation where text appears as if painted with a traditional brush, including visible brush texture and pressure variations. Think of this like the brush tool in video editing software with pressure sensitivity. The text should reveal using a combination of width scaling (scaleX) and opacity, simulating the brush moving across the surface. Add subtle texture using CSS filters and pseudo-elements for brush hair marks. Include a 'lift and press' effect where the opacity varies slightly along the stroke to show brush pressure changes. The animation should follow natural calligraphy timing - quick on upstrokes, slower on downstrokes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with TextAtom components using font-family 'Brush Script MT:400:normal' or similar. Apply initial scaleX(0) with transform-origin 'left center'. Generic keyframe effects: scaleX from 0 to 1 with variable duration based on character complexity (100-400ms per character). Secondary opacity effect oscillating between 0.85-1.0 at 50ms intervals for pressure variation. CSS filter: 'url(#roughPaper)' using SVG filter for texture. Add ::before pseudo-element via style prop with repeating-linear-gradient for brush hair texture. Use presetExecution helper to analyze character strokes and adjust timing. If using caption data, map word impact values to animation intensity.

prompts.prompt: Design a paper fold reveal animation where text appears to unfold from creases in paper, like opening an origami message. Visualize this as a 3D layer composition in video editing with perspective transforms. Each line of text should unfold from a different crease angle, using 3D rotations and perspective. Start with text rotated 90 degrees on X or Y axis (appearing as a line), then rotate to 0 degrees while simultaneously adjusting opacity and adding a subtle shadow that changes with the rotation angle. Include paper texture overlay and slight color temperature shift as the 'paper' unfolds into view.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'preserve-3d' style and perspective(1000px). Each text line in separate BaseLayout with 'transform-style-preserve-3d'. Initial state: rotateX(90deg) or rotateY(90deg) alternating per line, opacity 0. Generic keyframe effects: rotate from 90 to 0 degrees (800ms, cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)), opacity from 0 to 1 (400ms delay, 400ms duration). Dynamic box-shadow using style prop: '0 ${10 * (1 - progress)}px ${20 * (1 - progress)}px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'. Paper texture: ::after pseudo-element with background-image repeating pattern. Stagger each line by 200ms. Use sub-preset for individual fold animations if multiple text blocks needed.

prompts.prompt: Build a fountain pen writing animation with realistic ink flow simulation. Think of this like rotoscoping actual fountain pen footage with attention to ink pooling and flow dynamics. The text should appear progressively with varying ink intensity - darker where the pen pauses, lighter during quick movements. Add microscopic ink splatter details during fast strokes. Include a subtle 'nib reflection' effect that moves along the text path as it's being written. The animation should capture the elegance of fountain pen calligraphy with proper ink bleeding at connection points between letters.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: TextAtom components with clip-path animation revealing text progressively. Use linear-gradient mask for ink intensity variations: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,1) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) 50%, rgba(0,0,0,1) 100%)'. Animate mask-position from -100% to 200% for flow effect. Nib reflection: absolute positioned div with className 'w-2 h-2 bg-gradient-radial from-white to-transparent opacity-60' animated along text baseline using translateX. Ink pooling: use text-shadow with multiple layers, animating blur radius from 2px to 0.5px where pen would pause (detected via presetExecution analyzing character positions). Micro splatters: small absolutely positioned divs with 'w-0.5 h-0.5 bg-current' appearing randomly during fast sections (high velocity between keyframes).

prompts.prompt: Create a watercolor wash text effect where letters appear as if painted with watercolor, including color bleeding, paper absorption, and pigment granulation. Imagine compositing multiple watercolor texture layers in video editing. Start with text having soft, irregular edges using SVG filters for turbulence. Animate from high transparency with color spreading beyond boundaries, to more opaque with colors settling within letter forms. Add random color variations within each letter using multiple gradient stops. Include subtle paper warping effect using slight perspective transforms that shift during the animation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with TextAtom using SVG filter for edges: 'url(#watercolor)' where filter includes feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap. Initial state: scale(1.2) with opacity 0.3 and blur(3px). Generic keyframe effects: scale from 1.2 to 1 (1200ms, ease-out), opacity from 0.3 to 0.8 (1000ms), blur from 3 to 0.5 (1400ms). Background gradient via style prop with multiple color stops animating position. Add slight rotateX/Y variations (±2deg) using transform. Multiple text-shadow layers with different colors and blur values for bleeding effect. If using caption data, vary color intensity based on word sentiment values. Consider sub-preset for watercolor texture generation.

prompts.prompt: Develop a vintage typewriter effect with mechanical precision and ink ribbon imperfections. Think of this as recreating stop-motion animation of actual typewriter keys striking paper. Each character should appear with a sharp impact (slight scale bounce), accompanied by subtle position shifts simulating paper movement. Add random opacity variations for worn ribbon sections. Include occasional character misalignment (1-2px offset) and varying boldness to simulate mechanical inconsistencies. The timing should be irregular, mimicking human typing rhythm with occasional pauses between words.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Individual TextAtom per character wrapped in BaseLayout with 'inline-block relative'. Initial opacity 0, scale(0.8). Impact animation: scale from 0.8 to 1.1 to 1 (100ms total, spring easing). Random translateY between -2px and 2px for paper shift. Opacity variations: 0.7-1.0 randomly per character. Use monospace font 'Courier New:400:normal'. Timing: base 80ms per character with random variation ±30ms, word gaps add 100-200ms pause. Apply filter 'contrast(1.3) brightness(0.9)' for ink ribbon effect. Use presetExecution to generate random variations array. Add subtle container shake (translateX ±1px) on each keystroke using parent BaseLayout animation.

prompts.prompt: Design an ink reveal using capillary action simulation, where text appears as ink being absorbed through paper fibers. Visualize this like macro photography of ink spreading through paper - starting from multiple seed points and growing organically. Use noise-based mask animations to create natural, non-uniform spreading patterns. The ink should appear to travel along invisible paper grain lines with varying speeds. Add subtle color separation effect where different pigments in the ink spread at slightly different rates (cyan, magenta, yellow offsets).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: TextAtom with custom SVG mask using feNoise and feColorMatrix. Animate mask opacity and position to create spreading effect. Use CSS variables for seed points: '--seed-x', '--seed-y' with random values per word. Apply multiple mask layers for grain direction. Color separation: use three overlapping TextAtom copies with 'mix-blend-mode: multiply', slight translateX/Y offsets (0.5px), and different timing offsets (50ms). Main animation: mask-size from '0% 0%' to '120% 120%' with custom bezier (0.37, 0, 0.63, 1). Add turbulence filter animation for organic edges. Duration: 800-1200ms per word. Use internal effect preset 'capillary-spread' for mask animation. Consider audio-reactive timing if background music present.

prompts.prompt: Implement a 'invisible ink' heat reveal effect where text appears as if exposed to heat or UV light, gradually becoming visible. Think of this as a chemical reaction captured in time-lapse video. Start with text completely invisible (or very faint), then reveal through a combination of color temperature shift (cool to warm), increasing contrast, and subtle glow that peaks and settles. Add particle effects suggesting chemical activation - small dots that appear, glow, and fade around the text. The reveal should have an organic, temperature-map quality with hotspots appearing first.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with TextAtom starting at opacity 0.05, filter 'hue-rotate(-30deg) saturate(0.3) brightness(1.5)'. Generic keyframe effects: opacity to 1 (1500ms), filter animating hue-rotate to 0deg, saturate to 1, brightness to 1. Add glow effect using text-shadow animation: from 'none' to '0 0 20px rgba(255, 200, 100, 0.8)' to '0 0 5px rgba(255, 200, 100, 0.3)'. Particle system: repeatChildrenProps generating 10-15 divs with 'absolute w-1 h-1 rounded-full' positioned randomly around text bounds. Particles animate opacity and scale with 200-400ms duration, random delays creating activation wave. Use gradient-based hotspot mask: radial-gradient with animated radius from 0% to 150%. If using caption data, trigger reveal based on word timing with 100ms pre-roll for chemical reaction buildup.
